artworks.title: Saint Jerome by the Pollard Willow
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed slightly within plate mark): 20.7 × 17.8 cm (8 1/8 × 7 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated bearded man in a rocky alcove with his hands clasped in front of him. He is looking at an open book on a flat surface and there is a lion lying at his feet. In the background, there is a large crucifix, rocky formations, sparse vegetation, and a tree. An inscription with the date "1512" is visible.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Seated by a Tree
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman seated with a child on her lap. The woman supports the child with her left arm and holds its hand with her right. The woman has relaxed facial features and wavy, shoulder-length hair partially covered by a headpiece. She wears a long gown with intricate folds, wrapped around her shoulders and legs. The child is depicted nude, leaning against the woman. There is no visible jewelry. The background features a wooden fence, wild plants, a body of water, and a cityscape in the distant background under a calm sky. Inscriptions "1513" and a monogram are near the top of the image.

artworks.title: Knight, Death and Devil
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.8 x 10.1 cm (9 3/4 x 4 in.)
artworks.description: A man wearing a full suit of armor rides a horse on a narrow path alongside a ghoulish, skeletal creature wrapped in snakes and a goat-headed, horned creature, all set again sheer, rocky outcroppings that nearly fill this vertical engraving. The scene is created with fine, black lines built up in hatching and crosshatching to make deep shadows, and is printed on cream-white paper. The armored man rides toward our left in profile with a long lance resting on his right shoulder, farther from us, and the other hand holding the muscular horse’s reins. The lance extends off both sides of the paper and is wrapped with a fox’s tail near the top. The man’s face is wrinkled with deep-set eyes staring straight ahead. He has a prominent, bumped nose and wide mouth closed in a line, with the corner we can see pulled slightly up. The visor of his helmet is pushed up but his eyes are shielded from the creatures beyond the horse by the flaring sides of his helmet. Armor covers every inch of his body, including his hands and feet, and a long sword hangs at his left hip, closer to us. Spanning the width of the composition, his muscular horse walks with one front and one back leg raised and its chin pulled back, also looking straight ahead. A long-haired dog runs in the same direction between the horse’s feet over a lizard scrambling in the opposite direction. Seen between the armored man’s body and his horse’s head, the ghoulish creature at the side of the dirt path wears a spiky crown entwined with a snake and another serpent winds across his shoulders. The creature looks toward the armored man with round, piercing eyes, a hole where the nose should be, and a nearly toothless, gaping maw. He has a long, lanky beard and hair, and he holds up an hourglass topped with a clock-like dial. This creature also rides a horse, whose head hangs close to the ground. To our right, the goat-headed creature looks toward the armored rider with round eyes and its long snout slightly open to show fangs and teeth. Horns curl down to its shoulders and one long, sharp horn, dotted with spikes at the base, curves up and back over the creature’s face. It holds a double-pronged, spear-like halberd like a walking stick. Immediately beyond the group, rocky outcroppings push into the sky. The branches of barren trees and bushes are outlined against the blank, white sky and their craggy roots poke out of the rock. High on a hill in the deep distance is a castle complex or town. A plaque near a human skull resting on a tree stump in the lower left corner has the date of the print and the artist's monogram. "S. 1513" is followed by a "D" between the long legs of a capital "A."

artworks.title: The Sudarium Held by Two Angels
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures of winged beings positioned on either side of a central head held between them on a cloth. The angels are shown in a hovering or floating position, with their draped garments billowing around them. Their facial features are delicately detailed, with both angels having curly hair that frames their expressions. They are dressed in elaborate robes with folds and textures. The central head they hold on a cloth displays strong facial features with a beard and an intense gaze. The background has minimal detail, emphasizing the figures. Below the scene, there is a small area with a date and a monogram, indicating the creation year "1513" and the artist's signature.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Seated by the Wall
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on stone steps, holding a child. The woman is wearing draped clothing and a head covering. The child has chubby facial features and curly hair, dressed in simple garments. The woman has a serene expression and the child appears relaxed. In the background, there is a landscape with a river, distant castles, and tree-lined hills.

artworks.title: Melencolia I
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 24.2 x 18.8 cm (9 1/2 x 7 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: Created with fine black lines printed on an ivory-white paper, a winged woman sits with her head in one hand, surrounded by tools, a dog, and a baby-like, winged putto perched on a millstone, all in front of a distant landscape with a still body of water under an arched rainbow in this vertical engraving. Filling the lower right quadrant of the composition, the winged woman, Melencolia, sits with her body angled to our left, and she looks in that direction from under furrowed brows. Lit from our right, her face is cast in shadow, but she has a straight nose and her lips are closed. She wears a ring of leaves over hair that falls in waves over her shoulders. Wings curve up from her back, and she wears a long-sleeved dress with a tight bodice and a voluminous, pleated skirt. She rests her chin on one tightly closed fist. The other arm rests on a book in her lap, and she holds one of the two legs of a tall compass in that hand. Several keys hang on a ribbon looped onto her belt, and they nestle into the deep folds of her skirt. Around her feet are a purse cinched closed, several nails, the metal tip of a bellows, a saw, a plane, the end of a pair of pincers, an ink pot, a molder’s form for baseboards, and a round sphere about the size of a basketball. The dog lies in a tight circle to our left of Melencolia’s feet, its chin resting across its paws. The dog’s ribs show through the short fur of its hide. Next to the dog, the millstone leans against the building that fills the right half of the composition. The millstone is round and flat, is about the height of the woman's torso, and a hole is cut from its center. A chubby child sits atop the stone. It has short, curly hair, stubby wings, a loose robe, and it draws on a tablet propped on its lap. Beyond the child, a wooden ladder leans against the building, and a pair of scales hangs above his head. On the face of the building, hanging over Melencolia’s head, is an hourglass with the sand about halfway spent and a magic square, which is a grid of four rows and four columns. The numbers in the grid read, from left to right, 16, 3, 2, 13 in the top row; an upside down 5, a 10, 11, and 8 in the second row; a backward 9, a 6, 7, and 12 in the third row; and a 4, 15, 14, and 1 in the bottom row. A bell hangs from a ring above this grid. On the step beyond the sleeping dog and millstone, another large stone is carved into flat planes to create an irregular, geometric, rhomboid form about as tall as the millstone. A hammer lies in front of the rhomboid, and beyond it is a melting pot sitting among tongues of flame in a mug-like cup. In the upper left quadrant of the composition, a placid body of water leads back to a distant town and small boats, beneath a starburst that fills the sky. An arched rainbow crosses the sky over a rat-like bat with its sharp teeth and tongue showing. It holds a banner reading “MELENCOLIA I.” The artist signed and dated the engraving as if he had carved into the front face of the step on which Melencolia sits, near the lower right corner: “1514 AD,” with the uppercase D nestled between the long legs of the wide, uppercase A.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in His Study
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.7 × 18.7 cm (9 3/4 × 7 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with fine but densely spaced black lines, a man hunches over a table writing in the far corner of a room in this vertical engraving. A lion and a dog lie on the floor closer to us, both with their eyes closed. Arched window openings along the left wall are filled with bullseye glass, and that wall is lined with a bench. A chest and a pair of slippers are tucked under the bench, closer to us. On the bench are three books and two pillows. In the window well closer to us is another book and a skull. The man sits at a square table with trestle legs in the far corner next to the second bay of windows. A small crucifix is at the front left corner of the table. The man, who is balding with long hair, wears a cassock and heavy robes. His feet and knees are pressed together, and his hands are close to each other on the angled writing surface. A glow around his head creates a halo. The only other object on the table is his ink pot. On the far wall are an hourglass, a flat topped, wide-brimmed hat, a rosary, and hand broom. Pieces of paper and a pair of scissors tucked into bands pinned to the wall, and a shelf above holds candles and vessels. The ceiling is made of wood beams, and a pear-shaped gourd hangs at the top right corner. A wide chair holding a cushion sits near the table, and the artist’s initials, AD, and the date, 1514, are on a tablet that lies on the floor nearby.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing with a long staff in his left hand and a closed book against his body with his right hand. The man has long, bushy hair and beard. Lines radiate from his head. He is dressed in a long robe with wide sleeves. The area surrounding him is sparse, with grass at his feet and a stone block with engraved markings to his left. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image displays an elderly man standing upright. He is dressed in a long draped garment that covers him from shoulders to feet. The man's facial features include a long flowing beard and wavy hair, with a serene expression. His surroundings consist of a textured wall, a waterfront landscape, a small boat, a distant landmass visible across the water, and a sword near his feet. The figure holds a book.

artworks.title: Bagpiper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing against the trunk of a tree. He is depicted in profile, with one foot crossed over the other. He has a long beard and moustache, deep-set eyes, and is wearing a headscarf and loose-fitting garments with intricate details. He is holding a bagpipe and appears to be playing it. The background is a simple landscape, and the image is rendered in a monochromatic, detailed engraving style.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple Dancing
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 x 7.3 cm (4 9/16 x 2 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures, one in the foreground and one slightly behind. The person in the foreground is leaning forward with one foot off the ground. They have a broad, rounded face, short hair covered by a headscarf, and wear a dress with decorative fasteners and large sleeves. They hold a set of keys. The person in the background has outstretched arms, short, curly hair, and wears a layered cloak with a belt. The background is plain with a subtle texture, displaying the date "1514" and an artistic monogram at the top.

artworks.title: The Desperate Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.1 x 13.9 cm (7 1/2 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in varying poses and states of dress. In the center, a muscular figure sits with its upper body uncovered, supporting another man who looks ahead. On the left, a person in ornate clothing stands in profile. To the right, a reclining nude figure with draped fabric covering part of their body can be seen. In the upper center, a figure with curly hair and muscular torso holds a decapitated head. The background features a rocky landscape, a structure resembling an ark, and foliage.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows Seated
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body view of a seated figure. The person is sitting on a stone or a block-like structure, with both legs visible and one hand held up near the chest. The facial features include a long face with a curly beard and hair. The person's head is encircled with a crown of thorns, and straight rays radiate outward. They are wearing a long, loose garment that covers part of their body from the waist down. They hold a bundle of sticks or rods in one hand. The background is a plain surface. The numbers "1515" are present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling with his body turned slightly to the left. He has long, wavy hair and a beard. His hands are clasped together in front of him. The man is dressed in loose robes. Around him, the land is rocky with scattered vegetation. Behind him to the left, there are two other figures with trees and a path leading into the landscape. In the sky above him, there is a head with flowing hair surrounded by clouds and emanating rays of light toward the man. The background includes a large tree, clouds, and atmospheric details, creating a dramatic setting.

artworks.title: Abduction on a Unicorn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.7 × 20.9 cm (12 1/16 × 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological creatures in a dynamic scene. A centaur is depicted engaging with a unicorn. The background consists of swirling clouds and a rugged landscape. The drawing includes intricate details showing the textures and forms of the creatures. The style resembles an old master's engraving style.

artworks.title: The Sudarium Held by One Angel
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed line drawing of angelic beings in a celestial scene. Central figure appears with flowing garments and wings, holding a cloth or scroll. Smaller figures below engage in various activities amidst swirling clouds and dramatic sky. The intricate line work reflects early 16th-century woodcut or engraving techniques, emphasizing texture and depth through hatching and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent with a Sceptre and a Starry Crown
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a child. The woman has a gentle tilt to her head and appears to be looking at the child. She has detailed facial features, long flowing hair, and wears a crown. Her clothing is adorned with draped fabric. The child is naked and appears to be looking outward, resting in the woman's left arm. The woman holds a staff in her right hand. Radiating lines create a halo effect in the background. The number "1516" is inscribed to the right, and an artist's monogram is at the bottom right.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Crowned by Two Angels
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a stone holding a child in her lap. The woman has delicate features, long flowing hair, and a serene expression. She wears a detailed gown. The child has curly hair and is dressed in simple clothing. Two winged angels hover above, holding crowns. In the background, there is a rustic fence, hills, and trees. An object with inscriptions is near the woman's feet. The scene conveys tranquility and reverence.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion called the Sword Pommel of Maximilian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (diameter; trimmed to platemark): 3.81 cm (1 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing includes a man on a cross at the center, surrounded by several figures with halos around their heads. The central figure has a cloth around the waist, arms outstretched on the beam of the cross, and head tilted downwards. Below the cross is a skull and crossbones symbol. Additional figures on both sides of the cross have different expressions and gestures, possibly engaged in mourning or contemplation. The artwork is set within a circular border, reminiscent of a medallion. The figures' attire and shading demonstrate a high level of technical skill typical of print or engraving art often associated with the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion called the Sword Pommel of Maxmilian
artworks.artist: Hieronymus Wierix and Antonie Wierix after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central figure on a cross, surrounded by rays of light emanating from the circular boundary. Flanking the central figure are individuals adorned in draped garments, standing solemnly on either side. One of the figures at the base of the cross seems to be supporting the central figure. The composition is detailed, with elements like a skull on the ground and intricate folds of fabric enhancing the depth and contrast of the black and white illustration. The setting is composed within a circular frame.

artworks.title: The Virgin Nursing the Child
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure of a woman with a child in her arms. The woman has soft facial features and styled hair under a draped head covering, wearing detailed clothing with fur trims. She is surrounded by light rays emanating from a halo. The child, with curled hair, looks up at the woman. They are both clad in fabric. The background has fine lines radiating outward, with an artist's monogram and a dated plaque at the base.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple at Market
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing side by side. On the left is an older woman hunched slightly forward, holding onto the arm of the man next to her. She wears a headscarf, layered garments, and is next to a basket and a jug with a rooster. The man on the right stands upright with short wavy hair, a beard, and wears a tunic, belt, leggings, and boots. The background features a simple landscape and a structure in the distance. The image is an engraving with the date "1519" at the top and a monogram "AD" near the man's feet.
